messages.text: Three regions down. Next: Gilas, Stampede, Jackpots, Mile-Highs, Roadrunners.
Phoenix Saturday: 109 degrees. the ball goes soft at 105. I looked it up
WE GOT A FAN PAGE NOW 📈 41 FOLLOWERS. FORTY. ONE.
38 of them are Dre's cousins
AND THEY ARE ALL VERY SUPPORTIVE
Desert don't read fan pages, youngin. Bring water. Then bring more.
Car has AC now. Paid for it out the trophy fund. We have a trophy fund.
Phoenix first. hydrate
{crew}. Lou. Word travels. Southwest crews been watching your tape.
Nobody's sneaking up on anybody anymore. Least of all you.
good. no more sneaking
So you're {crew}. Seen the clips. Ever played on blacktop at 110?
Our court don't get shade till 7pm. By then you'll be done.
VENOM STRIKE hits slow. You don't feel it till the 5th inning.
we'll bring sunscreen
Gilas are 9-2 at home in July. visitors score 3 runs. then they take naps
I bought a cooling towel 🧊 it says COOL on it. I feel cool already
Ball stays in the cooler till first pitch. I asked Lou. It's legal.
Heat is patient, youngin. Be more patient.
WE BEAT THE HEAT ☀️🔥 AND THE GILAS. THAT'S TWO THINGS
Heatwave Hector threw 80 pitches. by the 6th the ball was a pancake
Saguaro Slam asked where we got the cooler. I said the block. He nodded.
THE COOLING TOWEL WORKED. y'all laughed
it melted Dre
Desert respects a crew that finishes standing. Y'all stood.
Dallas next
Told you. Venom's slow. Hope the ride home got AC, {crew}.
112 by the 4th. not making excuses. making a spreadsheet
run it back. earlier
yo. never seen a crew from outside the desert last nine at 110.
Capi says we win cause of the heat. I wanna win cause I'm good.
what you bring?
I don't sweat. Doctor says it's weird. Blacktop says it's a gift.
Got room on {crew} for somebody who stays dry?
Howdy, {crew}. Everything's bigger in Dallas. Including your L.
When we TRAMPLE, we don't stop at third. We don't stop at home either.
Fair Park, Saturday. Wear boots. It's gonna get dusty.
we'll bring a broom
Stampede score 4 a game on the bases alone. they don't slide. they arrive
so we just gotta STOP A STAMPEDE 🐂 easy. right? RIGHT??
You don't stop a stampede, youngin. You step aside and tag the last one.
Hotel's booked. One room. Pops snores. Bring earplugs or bring peace.
STAMPEDE?? MORE LIKE STAMPE-DONE 😂🐂
that's worse than Bully Fall and I respect it
Big D Brahma got tagged 3 times. kept running like the bases owed him money
Deep Ellum Duke tipped his hat at me. A real hat. Felt like a movie.
Next town plays with your head, youngins. Vegas.
VEGAS BABY 🎲✨
we're going for kickball Dre
Vegas. poker faces on
Y'all got trampled, partner. Don't take it personal. Everybody does.
Dust off, youngin. We been run over before. Ask my bus.
back saturday
Howdy. Duke says Stampede ball is run and don't think.
Y'all think AND run. Bases loaded and nobody on your side panicked.
looking for a new herd?
Looking for a herd that's headed to Nationals.
Got a saddle open on {crew}?
Welcome to Vegas, {crew}. Your odds tonight? 9 to 1. I set 'em myself.
We go ALL IN every inning. And The House never folds. He's our catcher.
Under the neon. 9pm. Dress code is shine.
we'll bring our own lights
Jackpots run hot 6 games, cold 4. they're 6 games into hot. do the math
I did the math. it says WE'RE THE JACKPOT 💰✨
that's not math
First kick's at 9pm. Pops, that's past your bedtime.
I ran this block till 2am in '98, youngin. I'll be up.
WE BROKE THE BANK 💰💰 THE HOUSE LOST. THE HOUSE NEVER LOSES
The House is their catcher. he lost. it's literal AND great
Hollis asked how we read Lady Luck's pitch. I said Keys has a spreadsheet.
it's a binder now
Luck runs out, youngins. Practice don't.
WE'RE ON A BILLBOARD ON THE STRIP 😭
That's a phone, Dre. You're holding a phone up to a billboard.
Denver. thin air
House always wins, {crew}. Thanks for playing. Valet's out front.
they bought us a buffet after. I'm sad but I'm FULL
run it back
Real talk. Hollis bets the whole game on one kick. Every inning.
I'm tired of all in. I want a crew that grinds.
you can grind?
First pitch till the Strip turns its lights off. And it never does.
So what are my odds on {crew}?
{crew}. We play a mile up. Your lungs are about to file a complaint.
Ball flies further up here. So do we. THIN AIR, baby.
Bring a jacket. It snowed in June once. Mid-game. We kept playing.
we did the Midwest. we got jackets
kicks go 9% further in Denver. ours too. theirs too. it's a wash
I ran ONE lap around the hotel. I SAW MY ANCESTORS 😵
Oxygen cans in the trunk. Two each. Pops gets three.
I don't need oxygen, youngin. I need a chair.
WE WON A MILE UP 🏔️🏔️ STILL CAN'T BREATHE BUT WE WON
Rocky Ridge Rhett kicked one into a parking lot. we still won by 4
Peak Pressure said we're the first visitors who never used the oxygen.
I used two.
Pops you sat the whole game
Sitting a mile up is still work, youngin.
ONE LEFT ON THE LADDER 🙏🙏
Albuquerque. let's run
Air's thin. So was your lead. See you at sea level, {crew}.
lost by 1. at altitude. I'm scoring it a tie at sea level
run it back
Grew up a mile high. Never seen flatlanders play nine like that.
Peak says we're above everybody. I'm tired of looking down.
you can play at sea level?
Down there? I'll have lungs for days. I'll never get tired.
Got room on {crew} for a mountain kid?
{crew}. {captain} here. We don't post. We don't trash talk.
You ever see a roadrunner? No. You don't. That's the point. Beep beep.
When DUST DEVIL hits the bases, you'll be swatting sand for an inning.
Green chile's on us after. Win or lose. That's just manners.
see you saturday
31 steals in 6 games. Dust Devil Dom has never been thrown out. never
so we CATCH A ROADRUNNER 🐦💨 nobody ever has. good. we'll be first
Fast crews hate one thing, youngin. Waiting. Make 'em wait.
Last rung. Then the bracket. Then the West. Then...
I'm not saying it. Y'all know.
WE CAUGHT THE ROADRUNNER 🐦🏆 LADDER DONE!!!!
Dom got thrown out at second. first time ever. he stared at the ball like it lied
Fiesta Bea brought the green chile anyway. Like she promised. I'm emotional.
TASHA'S CRYING
It's pollen. And green chile.
Bracket's where buses break down, youngins. Check the tires.
tires checked
Beep beep, {crew}. Chile's still on us. Come eat.
they stole 6 bases. I wrote every one down. took a while
again
Diablo doesn't know I'm texting. Nobody sees what I do. I'm fast.
Y'all stood still and let us come to you. Never saw a crew that calm.
you wanna learn calm?
I'll learn calm. Y'all learn fast. Fair trade.
Spot on {crew} for a roadrunner?
{crew}. Lou. People call me about y'all now. I don't like calls.
Semi Saturday vs Denver. Final Sunday. Ball comes out the cooler at first pitch.
No outsider ever won the desert final. Just so you know what you're carrying.
we know
Bracket's locked. Two games. Then the West. Then I'm saying the word.
SHE'S GONNA SAY THE WORD 😭😭
we're 3 for 3 in brackets. I have never trusted a streak less
Same bus, different desert, youngins. Tires are good. Sleep.
6am. sunscreen
Rematch. We trained at 10,000 feet since. In a ski lot. No joke.
Desert air's thick. Down here we fly, {crew}.
we'll be waiting when you land
Mile-Highs kick 20% harder since we beat them. angry AND well-rested
WE'RE ANGRY AND WELL-RESTED TOO 😤
Dre slept four hours.
Every crew you beat comes back hungrier, youngin. Feed 'em nothing.
WE IN THE SOUTHWEST FINAL 🌵🏆
beat Denver twice. once up high, once down low. full coverage
Peak Pressure says they're going back up the mountain to think about it.
Roadrunner tomorrow. Don't chase it, youngins. Let it come to you.
let it come
Thin air got you twice, {crew}. Breathe easy. Somewhere else.
Lou says we can re-enter. Tank's already full.
then we're still in it
I said we don't trash talk. I'm keeping that.
But Albuquerque hasn't lost a home final in thirty years. Not once.
Green chile after. Like always. Win or lose, {crew}.
save us a plate
Thirty years they never lost at home. I know about thirty-year stories.
Mine's got a bus in it. Theirs got a streak. Tomorrow one of 'em ends.
52-48 Roadrunners. the 4 points is the heat. I factored the heat
I'M HYDRATED AND I'M READY AND I'M CRYING 😭💧
Cooler's iced. Dre, drink the water. Don't cry it.
southwest final. let's eat
WE WON THE SOUTHWEST!!!! FOUR REGIONS!!!! 🌵👑🔥
four regions. four brackets. I stopped doing spreadsheets. we're just good
Diablo brought the green chile. Shook every hand. Even Pops'. Twice.
Thirty-year streak. Gone. Hm.
Feels different from this side, youngins.
POPS IS CRYING AGAIN
Desert pollen. It's worse.
one more region
Thirty-one years. Chile's still on us, {crew}. Come eat.
Streaks end, youngin. Not tonight. Next time. Bracket's open.
again
Lou emailed. West Coast ladder opens Monday. LA, Oakland, Seattle, SD, Portland.
West crews been posting our clips since Miami. with captions. mean captions
THEY'RE STUDYING US 👀👀 WE'RE THE TAPE NOW
'98 we never saw the Pacific, youngins. Bus didn't make it past Ohio.
Car can't make LA either. We're flying. First plane for Pops.
I'll pack snacks for the bus.
it's a plane Pops
pack light. last stop
West Coast talks a lot. Let 'em. You won the desert without talking back.
See you at Nationals. I'm bringing the chile to Baltimore.
